The U.S. economy in August added 162,000 jobs, far more than expected. The unemployment rate remained unchanged at 4.1%.

Economists surveyed by Dow Jones had expected overall hiring of just 53,000 roles and a steady unemployment rate.

The system is broken.

You know the system is broken when stocks FALL after the US unexpectedly adds +162,000 jobs in a month, TRIPLING expectations.

Why? Because a strong jobs report means a higher chance of rate hikes.

This is the product 60-straight months of 2%+ inflation.
